structured_output.summary: The change implements %TypedArray%.prototype.entries in its one in-scope file, following the three spec steps with the step comments kept in place. Step 1 binds the this value. Step 2 calls validate_typed_array(agent, obj) with `?`, so abrupt completions propagate. Step 3 returns CreateArrayIterator with IterationKind::KeyValue over ta_record.object, which is the validated object. Errors are propagated, with no catch-all or default values. The only other edit renames the unused parameters to underscore-prefixed names and drops the placeholder `let _ = ...` line, which is part of the same function. The six remaining test262 failures come from the engine's own not-implemented BigInt path, not from anything faked. Nothing in the diff special-cases inputs.

The helper modules (support::typed_array::validate_typed_array and support::array_iterator::create_array_iterator) are outside the diff, so I could not inspect them. The gate's build and clippy results and the 24 new passing tests are consistent with the change.
